subject: October Disability Celebration Planning and Access Reports
overview: The commission discussed plans for a combined disability pride and resource event in October and reviewed two reports of accessibility issues and mistreatment at local businesses.

items.title: Logo and Branding Update
items.summary: Discussed utilizing the city seal with words representing the commission and incorporating multi-colored ribbons to educate the public on different disabilities.

items.title: Fall Event Planning
items.summary: Agreed to hold a celebration and resource fair in October focused on various abilities, and assigned planning tasks to commission members.

items.title: Carr Park Accessibility
items.summary: Received an update on ADA ramp construction at Carr Park and advocated for accessible paths and seating near playing fields.

items.title: Ordinance Review
items.summary: Distributed the city ordinance governing the commission for members to review for potential future updates or modernization.

items.title: Disability Access and Incident Reports
items.summary: Reviewed a report of a physical altercation involving a mobility-impaired shopper and a retail employee, as well as a tripping hazard reported at a local business.

items.title: Correspondence and Announcements
items.summary: Noted upcoming heritage and pride events and scheduled a briefing on Open Meeting Law from legal counsel for the next meeting.

items.title: Budget and Swag Update
items.summary: Reviewed one-time funding allocations for outreach materials, event speakers, and research support.
